parts: Blue gives the right text better odds five times in a row.
前五格，蓝模型都给了原文更高的概率。
Then it has to finish two plus two.
轮到填二加二的答案。
Blue picks five.
蓝模型选了五。
So who won?
所以，谁赢了？
Keep that last tile in sight while we rewind.
盯住最后那格，往回走。
What does it mean to guess the next piece of text?
猜下一块文字，究竟在猜什么？
Both models see exactly the same prefix.
两个模型读到同一段前缀。
Each divides a whole bar among possible next tokens.
每个模型把整条概率分给候选词元。
We keep the slice for the word the author actually wrote.
只留下分给原文的那一截。
It goes on the rail, and the real word slides into place.
记下概率，把原文词元推回纸带。
Even if Blue guessed wrong, its guess never becomes the next prefix.
哪怕蓝模型猜错，下一步也仍然读原文。
The two models get the same view all the way down.
两个模型始终看到同样的上下文。
Take a tiny sentence with just two tiles.
先拿一个只有两格的短句。
The model gives the first correct tile half the bar.
第一格的正确词元拿到一半。
Once that tile is in place,
接对第一格之后，
the second gets an eighth of what survived.
第二格再取剩下的八分之一。
Turn those cuts at right angles.
把两次切分转成直角。
The gold corner keeps the probability of both steps together.
金色一角，就是两步都接对的概率。
Copy the sentence and start from the same beginning.
复制一份短句，从同样的起点再测。
Each step is just as easy, but the joint probability shrinks again.
每格难度没变，乘积却又缩小。
How do we make the length of the paper stop deciding the score?
怎么去掉纸带长短对分数的影响？
Give both steps the same width.
把两步的概率拉成等宽。
Squeeze one side, stretch the other, and keep the area fixed.
一边收窄、一边拉长，面积保持不变。
The square's edge is the equivalent probability per token.
正方形的边长，就是等效的单词元概率。
Flip it: this is like choosing one tile out of four equally likely ones.
取倒数：相当于在四个等可能选项里猜一个。
That equivalent number is perplexity.
这个等效选项数，就是困惑度。
Four boxes measure difficulty. The actual vocabulary can be enormous.
四格只是刻度；实际词表可以很大。
For a book, the product gets too small for the computer to hold.
到了整本书，乘积会小得存不下。
Trade each probability for its surprise.
把每个概率换成它对应的惊讶值。
Every time the probability halves, add one bit.
概率每减半，惊讶值就多一比特。
That turns multiplication into stacking.
概率相乘，变成对数损失相加。
Stack a bit here. Three more there.
这里一块，那边再来三块。
Spread the stack equally across the two positions.
把整摞平均分给两格。
Raise two to that average and you're back on the perplexity scale.
用二的这个平均值次方，换回困惑度。
A single nearly impossible token makes a very tall stack.
一个极难预测的词元，就能堆得很高。
Now swing back to our six tiles.
现在转回开头的六个词块。
Blue takes a smaller hit on each of the first five.
前五格，蓝模型每次的损失都更小。
On the last tile its loss jumps.
到最后一格，它的损失突然跳高。
That jump can't erase the five small advantages.
这一下还没抵消积攒的优势。
So Blue has lower perplexity on the whole sentence.
因此蓝模型的整句困惑度更低。
Now look straight down the answer slot.
沿着答案那格看进去。
Here we score what the model picks.
这次只给模型选的答案打分。
Purple lands on four. The same probabilities give us two different winners.
紫模型选中四。同样的概率，评出两个赢家。
Hold the text still. Slide two token rulers over it.
固定原文，滑来两把分词尺。
One sees two pieces. The other sees four.
一把切成两块，另一把切成四块。
A per-token score now has a different unit on each side.
每词元的分数，分母单位已经不同。
Use the same tokenizer, or divide total surprise by the same raw bytes.
用同一套分词，或把总损失摊到同一原文的字节。
The mix of material matters, too.
材料配比也会改变结果。
Blue handles conversation better. Purple handles math better.
蓝模型更擅长对话，紫模型更擅长数学。
Shift the mix and you can flip the winner again.
拨动配比，领先者又能换边。
Paloma takes those separate domain measurements seriously.
Paloma 就按不同语域分别测量。
Suppose you're buying a system to sort customer mail.
假设你要采购一套客服邮件分拣系统。
Purple gets more right. Blue costs less per letter.
紫模型更准，蓝模型每封处理得更便宜。
Slide a budget limit across the floor.
把预算线沿地面推过来。
The best score can end up outside it.
分最高的方案可能被划到预算外。
That comparison helps you buy a system.
这场比较能帮你选系统。
For a claim about the algorithm, open the machines.
要比较算法，就把两台机器拆开。
Feed both the same training data and compute budget.
给两边相同的训练数据与算力预算。
Change the machinery you actually want to test.
只动你真正想测的那一件零件。
Back to that gold answer tile.
回到那块金色答案砖。
Imagine the rail carries a thousand of them.
想象轨道上有一千块答案砖。
Check each answer and you've got a test score.
逐个对答案，就得到考试分数。
Now watch both models climb almost to the ceiling.
看，两个模型都快顶到满分。
Where does a better model go from there?
更强的模型，还能在哪儿拉开差距？
